crash_loop.title: Tailcat tunnel keeps crashing
crash_loop.description: The tunnel "{name}" has failed to stay running too many times in a row and automatic restarts have been paused. Check the Home Assistant logs for details, fix the underlying issue, then restart the tunnel from its "Restart tunnel" button.
